claims.claim_text: Democrats believe the United States has an indispensable role in solving the climate crisis and that Democrats have an obligation to help other nations address climate change.
U.S. leadership in domestic clean-energy development is driving a global cycle of innovation and investment.
U.S.-led global clean-energy innovation and investment will help lower clean-energy technology costs fairly and transparently for all nations.
Democrats regard international climate finance as an important tool for addressing the climate crisis.
The Biden administration committed to achieving $11 billion in annual climate financing by 2024 to help develop the international clean-energy market.
The Biden administration worked with other nations to achieve a global goal of mobilizing $100 billion in collective climate financing by 2022, fulfilling a 2015 Paris Agreement promise.
Democrats pledge to continue supporting increased funding for initiatives such as PREPARE, the U.S. program to improve early warning systems for climate impacts in critical world regions.
Democrats pledge to use U.S. leadership to drive global innovation and expand clean-energy supply chains.

Democrats pledge to work through the institution identified in their 2024 platform as the "Multilateral Development Bank" to elevate climate and clean-energy priorities in the global development-finance system.
Democrats pledge to build on U.S. leadership in innovative debt-for-nature swaps.

As of the 2024 Democratic platform, U.S.-led debt-for-nature swaps had helped countries including Barbados and Gabon restructure over $2 billion in debt, unlocking hundreds of millions of dollars for nature and climate investments.
